title: US Sanctions Italian Mafia Group in Canada and Australian Biker Gang with Global Footprint
snippet: The U.S. has sanctioned members of a Canada-based faction of Italy’s ‘Ndrangheta mafia, and an Australian outlaw motorcycle gang. Both work with Mexican cocaine cartels, according to the Treasury Department.

title: Accused South American Drug Lord Faces US Trial after Judge Rejects Motions
snippet: A federal judge rejected assertions of prosecutorial misconduct and vindictive prosecution, clearing the way for an accused South American drug baron’s jury trial.

title: Serbian Court Seeks Arrest of Kosovo Serb Kingpin Radoicic
snippet: Court asks police to issue arrest warrant for businessman and politician after he failed to report to police – violating measures imposed as part of probe into a 2023 shootout in the Kosovo village of Banjska/Banjske.

snippet: Just hours after the Supreme Court voided his passport, the defeated presidential candidate fled across the Argentine border to evade mounting fraud and money laundering probes. He landed in the United States.
